prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1399; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not put my full name on it right now, but I can confirm I was the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was at an intersection in League City, Texas. I was going through on a green light, heading straight through the crossroads.

Q: What happened as you entered the intersection?

A: A car came from my right side and didn't stop. It hit the passenger side of my vehicle. I didn't see it coming until the last second, and I couldn't swerve in time.

Q: Did you apply your brakes before impact?

A: Yes, I hit the brakes as hard as I could, but there wasn't enough room to stop.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. My left wrist hit the steering wheel and the door frame. The doctor at the urgent care said it's a fracture. I've got a splint on it now and I'm supposed to see an orthopedic specialist this week.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment at the scene?

A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They X-rayed the wrist and then sent me home with the splint and pain medication.

Q: Did anyone else in your vehicle get hurt?

A: No, I was alone in the car.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was following the traffic rules. I want the other driver's insurance to know I did nothing wrong.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
